name: MVP 29.4.1 – LLM Capability Gap Analyzer
description: Replaces keyword-based capability gap routing with an LLM-first semantic analyzer that compares the user request with Pandora's current tools, skills, knowledge and policies. Python validates the recommendation and prevents unrelated fallback tool execution.
features: ToolDevelopmentAgent now uses semantic LLM capability analysis instead of keyword gap detection as the routing decision
Coordinator and ChatService prevent unsafe fallback to unrelated tools when capability analysis reports a gap or is unavailable
Adds CLI command: python main.py capability-gap analyze <task>
Adds prime_number_calculation as concrete validation target for generated tool proposals
Adds prime-number fallback design/code/test generation for reviewable proposal validation
safety: No keyword or sentence-pattern detector decides missing capabilities as primary path
LLM recommends only; Python validates tool availability and policy
If capability analysis is unavailable, Pandora does not execute calculator or any unrelated fallback tool
No automatic activation of generated tools
Human approval remains mandatory before installation
tests: python -m py_compile main.py core/api.py core/capability_gap_analyzer.py core/tool_development_agent.py core/coordinator_agent.py core/chat_service.py core/tool_generator.py core/tool_test_generator.py core/tool_design_agent.py
python main.py capability-gap analyze 'Ich brauche ein Tool, das Prim-Zahlen berechnet.' --provider mock
CoordinatorAgent().run(... provider_name='mock') creates a VALIDATED prime_number_calculation proposal instead of using calculator
